Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-11-01

1. Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
Retell integrated OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra for its voice‑agent benchmark and added Codex to its stack, enabling the service to support 100 million monthly calls.

2. Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
Greptile rolled out a new workflow‑testing platform that harnesses GPT‑6 Astra to simulate real‑world user interactions, uses Daybreak to harden security layers, and integrates Codex to automatically refactor code and cut rework.

3. GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
CodeRabbit integrated OpenAI’s GPT‑6.1 Sol, a security‑focused AI agent, to automatically investigate and flag risks in large, intricate code repositories. The agent not only identifies potential vulnerabilities but also proposes concrete fixes that developers can vet.
